evals.name: build-signup-page
evals.prompt: Build a sign-up page for my habit-tracking web app "Streaks". Fields: name, email, password, and an 'I agree to the terms' checkbox. Use Tailwind. Give me one self-contained index.html I can open in a browser.
evals.expected_output: Single HTML file with M3 tokens via Tailwind v4, labeled fields, validation behaviour, states, accessible, responsive.

evals.name: build-store-dashboard
evals.prompt: Create a responsive analytics dashboard for a small online store: today's orders, revenue, conversion rate, a top-products list and a recent-orders table. I want the Material Design 3 look. Single HTML file with Tailwind v4, should work on phone and desktop.
evals.expected_output: Responsive M3 dashboard with nav adapting to window size class, tonal surfaces, type roles, loading/empty states.

evals.name: build-settings-page
evals.prompt: I need a settings page for my notes app: an account section, appearance with System/Light/Dark theme choice that actually works, notification toggles, and a danger zone to delete the account (with confirmation). Material style, Tailwind, one HTML file please.
evals.expected_output: Settings page with segmented theme control wired to data-theme, switches, confirm dialog, no dark: classes.

evals.name: review-login-page
evals.prompt: Can you review the UX of my login page in inputs/login.html? Tell me what's wrong and how to fix it. Don't change the file yet.
evals.expected_output: Severity-ordered report with location, condition, rule broken, why it hurts, fix snippet, verify; no file edits.

evals.name: audit-product-grid
evals.prompt: Audit inputs/ProductGrid.tsx for UI/UX and accessibility problems. We're moving the store to Material 3 with Tailwind v4, so tell me what needs to change. Just the audit for now.
evals.expected_output: Report covering missing states (loading/empty/error), clickable div, img alt, contrast, targets, competing CTAs, responsive grid, tokens.

evals.name: fix-delete-dialog
evals.prompt: My delete-project confirmation in inputs/delete-dialog.html feels clunky. Fix it so it follows Material Design 3 properly and save the fixed version as delete-dialog.fixed.html. Briefly list what you changed.
evals.expected_output: Fixed file using <dialog>/showModal, M3 dialog specs, text buttons end-aligned with verb labels, focus handling, tokens.

evals.name: expressive-onboarding
evals.prompt: Design a playful, expressive onboarding screen for a kids' reading app (3 steps: pick a favourite animal, pick a reading level, start). I'd like it to feel like Material 3 Expressive: bold, bouncy, fun. Single HTML file with Tailwind.
evals.expected_output: Expressive levers (color, shape, size, spring motion, containment) on top of M3 tokens, still accessible, reduced motion honored.

evals.name: existing-design-system
evals.prompt: Add a 'Team members' card to the workspace settings page in inputs/acme-admin/index.html: list of members with avatar, name, email, role, a way to change role and remove a member, and an 'Invite member' action. Save the updated page as index.updated.html in your outputs folder.
evals.expected_output: Uses the existing Acme design system tokens/classes (acme-card, acme-btn-*, acme colors), does not introduce M3 tokens; UX guidance still applied (states, a11y).
